changes_made.explanation: Changed task name to be more specific (KBQA) and added SPARQL queries as an output type since the framework generates both queries and natural language answers
Normalized metric names to standard capitalization and removed duplicate entries
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper - they are used as part of the generation framework only
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper - evaluation is purely automatic using precision, recall, and F1 scores

overall_notes: The paper presents a KBQA framework using LLM-based agents, but focuses on generating SPARQL queries and natural language answers from knowledge bases. Evaluation is entirely automatic using traditional information retrieval metrics. No LLM-as-judge or human evaluation is performed.
